subject: Music Production
title: Joe Meek's Homemade Studio
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Joe Meek's Homemade Studio.

hook.text: In 1960s London, Joe Meek built a recording studio inside his tiny flat above a leather shop.

buildup.text: He constructed equipment from spare parts and used bathroom tiles for reverb effects.

discovery.text: Meek's 1962 track 'Telstar' became the first British record to reach number one in America.

twist.text: He achieved a global hit using homemade gear that professional studios would have rejected.

climax.text: Meek proved that creativity and experimentation mattered more than expensive studio equipment.

punchline.text: A flat above a shop produced a worldwide number one.

quiz.question: What was notable about Joe Meek's studio setup?
options: It was the largest in London
It was built from spare parts in his flat
It was funded by a major record label
